item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 19/Mar/2023
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The easterly airstream affecting the coast of Guangdong will be gradually replaced by a southerly airstream today and tomorrow. It will be warm and humid with showers over the coastal areas early to midweek this week. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to southern China in the latter part of this week. Showers will increase and there will be thunderstorms over the coastal areas of Guangdong.
